entries.f6f9e72f12d5948d: Its main theme is growth and development, and it states that it will work on strengthening and expanding domestic business, re-entering overseas markets, and improving management efficiency. Its main initiatives are, in the Unit House Business, strengthening the opening of permanent and satellite showrooms, promoting used-unit sales, and improving the efficiency of order placement and receipt using AI; in the Modular and System Construction Business, promoting collaboration, strengthening proposal capabilities through the use of 3D estimating systems and VR and AI tools, and expanding modular construction showrooms; and in the Construction Machinery Rental Business, actively investing in profitable products and strengthening personnel. It states that it aims to establish itself as a "lightweight steel general contractor" in the low-rise construction market.

entries.fe607165594f9cc7: The company has a system in which it manufactures unit houses at its own factory and handles both sales and rental. Unit houses it lends out are collected, maintained and reused many times, and leased assets, the main assets of the Unit House Business, have increased for five consecutive years. In the rebuilding of the Yuki Factory, it has introduced fully automatic welding robots and is advancing labor savings in factory production.
